name: How long does a typical water intrusion assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical water intrusion assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a water intrusion assessment varies depending on the size and complexity of your property and the extent of the suspected damage. A basic residential assessment might take a few hours, while larger commercial properties or complex issues could require a full day or multiple visits. Factors like accessibility to the roof and interior areas, as well as the number of suspected entry points, can influence the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The assessment duration varies, typically from a few hours for basic residential cases to a full day or more for complex issues, depending on property size and damage extent.
